description: Adds a contact as the Add contact form does: a name, a phone (with area code) or an email is enough. contact_type picks client (default), lead, applicant, staff or other. A phone or email that already belongs to a contact is refused with that contact (duplicate_contact, its id in the message); use it, or pass createAnyway: true only for a different person who shares it (a shared phone then stays with its owner). Look a person up first with findClientByIdentifier or read. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the contact the first call made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: create_client
title: Add a contact
